title: Independent audit of durable Solana address-library PostgreSQL adapter
objective: Independently audit the offline PostgreSQL address-library adapter, including database trust constraints, verified-record preservation, typed observation persistence, and absence of live database or network execution.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify source, migrations, or tests.
Do not connect to or deploy PostgreSQL or Redis.
Do not call live Helius, RPC, market-provider, or HTTP APIs.
Do not activate BSC or unpark SOL-E2E-001.
